data.title: Multi-mission 2,800-pound robotic vehicle faces crucial field trials
data.description: The 82nd Airborne Division will test Hunter WOLF, a 2,800-pound-capacity robotic vehicle built for dismounted operations.
data.author: Aamir Khollam
data.keywords: 82nd Airborne Division, BLADE Robotics, Hunter Wolf, Military robotics, U.S. Army, UGV, Unmanned Ground Vehicle
